  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:

  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.

    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

    p=line.split(); sym.append(p[0]); xyz.append([float(x) for x in p[1:4]])
xyz=np.array(xyz)
cov={'H':0.31,'C':0.76,'S':1.05,'P':1.07,'Au':1.36}
bonds=set()
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        if np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j]) < (cov[sym[i]]+cov[sym[j]])*1.3: bonds.add((i,j))
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('ref.mol',removeHs=False)
